VERDICT    SCORE  CONFIDENCE  WORKLOAD                REPLICAS  CPU    SPOT  FINDINGS
not-ready  15     low         shop/statefulset/db     1         2000m  -     SR001,SR006,SR007,SR009
not-ready  35     high        shop/deployment/worker  2         2000m  -     SR003,SR004,SR005,SR006,SR009
ready      100    high        shop/deployment/web     3         1500m  -     

shop/statefulset/db
  SR001 [blocker] runs with 1 replica: an interruption means downtime (testdata/sample.yaml:50)
    Suggested remediation:
      Run at least 2 replicas (3 across zones is better), or give the HPA minReplicas: 2.

      # StatefulSet: spec
      replicas: 2
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/
  SR006 [caveat] container "db" has no readinessProbe: traffic can reach a pod that is not ready (testdata/sample.yaml:57)
    Suggested remediation:
      Add a readinessProbe so traffic only reaches pods that can serve it. Point it at your health endpoint.

      # spec.template.spec.containers[db]
      readinessProbe:
        httpGet:
          path: /healthz
          port: 8080
        periodSeconds: 5
        failureThreshold: 3
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/
  SR007 [caveat] uses persistent volumes: zonal disks make rescheduling slower and tied to one zone (testdata/sample.yaml:60)
    Suggested remediation:
      A zonal volume keeps the pod in one zone and slows rescheduling. Keep this workload on on-demand nodes, or accept slower recovery.

      # spec.template.spec
      nodeSelector:
        karpenter.sh/capacity-type: on-demand
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/
  SR009 [info] no preStop hook: in-flight requests may be cut when the node is reclaimed (testdata/sample.yaml:56)
    Suggested remediation:
      Add a short preStop sleep so the endpoint is removed from load balancers before the process gets SIGTERM.

      # spec.template.spec.containers[db]
      lifecycle:
        preStop:
          exec:
            command: ["sleep", "15"]
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/container-lifecycle-hooks/
shop/deployment/worker
  SR003 [caveat] terminationGracePeriodSeconds is 300s, but Spot gives only 120s of notice (testdata/sample.yaml:40)
    Suggested remediation:
      Make the application exit on SIGTERM within the 2-minute Spot notice and lower the grace period.

      # spec.template.spec
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 90
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle/
  SR004 [caveat] no topology spread or pod anti-affinity: replicas can land on the same node or zone (testdata/sample.yaml:39)
    Suggested remediation:
      Spread the replicas across zones and nodes.

      # spec.template.spec
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: worker
        - maxSkew: 1
          topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
          labelSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: worker
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/topology-spread-constraints/
  SR005 [caveat] no PodDisruptionBudget: draining can remove too many replicas at once (testdata/sample.yaml:33)
    Suggested remediation:
      Add a PodDisruptionBudget so a drain removes one replica at a time.

      apiVersion: policy/v1
      kind: PodDisruptionBudget
      metadata:
        name: worker
        namespace: shop
      spec:
        maxUnavailable: 1
        unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow
        selector:
          matchLabels:
            app: worker
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/run-application/configure-pdb/
  SR006 [caveat] container "worker" has no readinessProbe: traffic can reach a pod that is not ready (testdata/sample.yaml:42)
    Suggested remediation:
      Add a readinessProbe so traffic only reaches pods that can serve it. Point it at your health endpoint.

      # spec.template.spec.containers[worker]
      readinessProbe:
        httpGet:
          path: /healthz
          port: 8080
        periodSeconds: 5
        failureThreshold: 3
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes/
  SR009 [info] no preStop hook: in-flight requests may be cut when the node is reclaimed (testdata/sample.yaml:41)
    Suggested remediation:
      Add a short preStop sleep so the endpoint is removed from load balancers before the process gets SIGTERM.

      # spec.template.spec.containers[worker]
      lifecycle:
        preStop:
          exec:
            command: ["sleep", "15"]
    Docs: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/container-lifecycle-hooks/

3 workloads: 1 ready, 0 with caveats, 2 not ready (1 skipped)
Spot potential: 27% of requested CPU in long-running workloads (ready or with caveats; Jobs, CronJobs and ScaledJobs excluded).
